description: Erection of a side and rear roof extension, first floor rear extension and two front roof windows to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (3463/LFT-01/SP, 3463/LFT-02/SP, 3463/LFT-03/SP, 3463/LFT-04/SP: Received 26/10/2020. 
3463/LFT-05/SP Rev B, 3463/LFT-06/SP Rev B: Received 17/12/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extensions hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The side dormer window hereby approved shall be in obscure glazing and permanently retained as such with no openable part below 1.7 metres above finished floor level.
